title: The MCP dogfood's traced-notice check bounds the total number of phase lines
outcome: The MCP dogfood's traced-notice check bounds the total number of phase lines
acceptance: The integration check in scripts/mcp-dogfood.test.mjs fails when a phase notice appears for an id it did not expect, or twice for one id, by asserting that phaseNotices.length equals the sum of the per-id line counts

completion.summary: The MCP dogfood traced-notice check sums each called id's lines and asserts that phaseNotices.length equals that sum. A notice for an id never called fails the total, and a duplicate record for one id fails the per-id checks. Gate 9/9, the pair was clean, and the evaluation passed. Landed as 242249f and installed as build 5f72edbf.
